 Follow Khloé Kardashian unveils 'spectacular' winter wonderland transformation at $17 million home
 Maria Sarabi Tue, November 10, 2026 at 1:24 PM UTC 3 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. Khloe Kardashian posing for a photo, shared via Instagram (Instagram) Khloé Kardashian is getting in the festive spirit early as she transformed the exterior of her $17 million Hidden Hills mansion with glowing Christmas lights. 
 The reality star took to her Instagram Stories to show off her breathtaking holiday display on Instagram Stories, turning her estate into a glistening winter wonderland. Cool-toned lights draped the perimeter of the estate, illuminating the surrounding trees and lush greenery.
 "Pleadse always have time for me @christmasbrothers," penned Khloé alongside the video. Opting for a gingerbread-style aesthetic, the star trimmed only the architectural rooflines and borders of the house in crisp lights.
 Khloé Kardashian showed off her Christmas lights at her home (@ Instagram)
 "We're still setting up things, but I've never seen anything like this," Khloé shared in the video. "So I love when my house is gingerbread style, so basically just trim the perimeter of things, which I love."

 Khloé Kardashian shows off sculpted abs in micro bra 
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The podcast host then filmed a large tree that has been adorned with shimmering sparkles. "How bright and beautiful and majestic this tree is, and look, the Christmas Brothers go all the way to the tips of these branches. It looks like this is an X-ray and you're seeing its skeleton. It's so gorgeous, when we were getting it lit before we had to take this down and it was so pitch black and it's so crazy what this does. How peaceful and fairytale these lights make this. It's absolutely spectacular and I couldn't be any happier. Thank you," she said.
 Khloé hired the Christmas Brothers to illuminate her estate (@ Instagram)
 Khloé continued: "Going round the corner, I love the gingerbread style. How cute. So we outline and go around every window, all the window panes and the roof trimming, it's really so special."
 Located in the gated enclave of Hidden Hills, Khloé's home was built next door to her mother Kris Jenner's renovated property. After undergoing construction for two years, the reality star finally moved into the new-build back in 2021, with the home sitting on a 10,000 square foot piece of land.
 Khloé's home is worth $17 million (@ Instagram)
 During an episode of The Kardashians, Khloé opened up about her dream home. "It's just so great to finally see this be a tangible house," she said. "We're so excited that this is … where we get to create all our memories … and put our roots down. This is mine."
 Advertisement Advertisement The mother-and-daughter duo invested a total of $37 million to build neighboring mansions on the 4.4 acre land, with Kris spending over $20 million. Khloé sold her Calabasas home for $15.5 million eight months after the pair's joint expenditure. 
 The Kardashians' Palm Springs estates
 During a recent episode of The Kardashians , Kim Kardashian gave viewers a tour of Kris Jenner's La Quinta abode, featuring a hidden trail that connects the property to Kylie Jenner's home right next door.
 Kim Kardashian bought a neighboring home in Palm Springs (@ WireImage)
 "We made these so we can all get to each other the back way instead of going the front way," shared Kim. The reality star explained that a home between the two luxury estates was on the market and that she toyed with the idea of buying it so the hidden pathways could be extended to a third property.
 "Can you imagine?" she asked, noting that it "would be so much fun" to continue their "little backyard connections."
 Advertisement Advertisement "He offered me the same price, so if I just sell one for half, then I'm close to Kylie, and this view is so much better," she added. In a confessional interview, Khloé revealed that Kim eventually bought the house. "She bought it," Khloé said. "She actually bought it, so all of this works out for the best."
